artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight with Joseph in Adoration
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene depicting figures in nature. The image is an intricately detailed line drawing set during a moment of rest under large trees, with foliage forming a canopy overhead. In the central part of the scene, a seated figure is depicted beside a small animal lying on the ground. Other figures are gathered around, one reclining and another in a kneeling position, seemingly offering something. The landscape features trees and possibly a body of water in the background. Textural details are evident in the pattern of leaves and the folds of drapery, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Dupas Deposition (Déposition Dupas)
artworks.description: The sketch shows a group of people portrayed from the waist up, positioned closely together. The facial features are detailed with fine lines and capture various expressions, while the hairstyles vary from slicked back to short or covered with hats. The individuals wear formal attire, such as suits and uniforms, with one figure wearing glasses. The background is a blank space with minimal lines, highlighting the group of figures.

artworks.title: Ribot Deposition (Déposition Ribot)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch showing a group of people in what appears to be a courtroom or formal setting. Among the figures, one person is standing while several others are seated. The standing person is shown in a side profile view, with a bald head, mustache, and wearing formal attire that includes a long coat. He is holding a cane or walking stick in one hand. The seated individuals and others in the background are dressed in similar formal clothing with some wearing hats and are depicted in varying degrees of detail and with shaded or sketched facial features. The background has minimal detail, focusing on the figures who are gathered closely, likely seated on benches or pews.

artworks.title: Soudais Deposition (Déposition Soudais)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of several men standing close together in what appears to be a courtroom or official setting. The men are depicted from the waist up, with minimal facial details. They wear formal 19th-century clothing, including high collars and some with academic or judicial caps. One man in the forefront holds a top hat, and there is a lightly sketched background of an interior space with drapery in the distance.

artworks.title: Clifton from Kingsweston
artworks.description: The image showcases a landscape view from an elevated angle, encompassing rolling hills with a horizon in the distance. The sky above displays soft pink, orange, and light blue tones, suggestive of dawn or dusk. A silhouette of a structure appears along the horizon. The artwork features watercolor techniques with fluid brushstrokes and a warm, earthy color palette. Fields, trees, and a valley create layers leading towards the horizon.

artworks.title: The Discovery of an East Window of All Saints’ Church, behind High Street, Bristol
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a partially demolished building with a Gothic-style arch as a prominent feature. The structure is worn, with remaining walls defining the horizon and scaffolding framing the scene. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes conveying texture and detail, with a color palette of muted grays, off-white tones, and hints of pink. A wooden gate is partially open, a ladder leans against a wall, and three figures are near the gate. Signs on a fence read "48 WIN ST RU." The composition leads the viewer to observe architectural features and activity below.

artworks.title: A Mountainous Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river, a figure on horseback, cattle, distant hills, and mountains. The brushstrokes are soft, with delicate shading indicating trees and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of gray and sepia. The sky is lightly clouded, portraying a calm rural scene.

artworks.title: Sailboat on a Beach
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated viewpoint overlooking an scene with a gentle, muted atmosphere. The horizon is placed in the middle of the composition, where land and water meet, intersected by faint structures and the masts of ships. These ships are beyond a small shoreline to the right. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, with soft edges that suggest forms, creating a dreamy effect. The color palette consists of warm sepia tones, varying shades of brown and gray, giving the scene a soft, monochromatic appearance.

artworks.title: Carrigogunniel
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a castle-like structure in the distance placed in the upper third of the composition. The structure is partially obscured by leafy trees in muted yellow and green tones. The foreground features earth tones in rust and brown hues with a small body of water reflecting blue. The sky above is broad and expansive with light blue and white washes and fluffy clouds. The brushstrokes are gentle and impressionistic.

artworks.title: Horstead Mill on the River Bure, Norfolk
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a wide perspective over a pastoral scene. Foliage dominates the horizon line separating the sky from the land and water below. There are buildings, including a large white structure with gable-ended roofs, along the horizon. The soft watercolor brushstrokes blend colors to create a serene atmosphere. The color palette includes greens, oranges, pastels, and subtle reflections on the water. The scene captures the stillness of the waterway and the open sky above.

artworks.title: Landscape with Cattle (Somerset?)
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 17.5 x 27.3 cm (6 7/8 x 10 3/4 in.)
overall: 40.6 x 55.9 cm (16 x 22 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a viewpoint from an elevated position overlooking a rolling countryside towards the horizon. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, where the grassy hills meet the sea and sky. A distant lighthouse, trees, and small structures can be seen. The painting features delicate watercolor brushstrokes blending colors like browns, greens, and golden tones. The sky is predominantly blue and gray with sunlight breaking through clouds. In the foreground, there are cows grazing and a fieldworker near them.

artworks.title: Landscape with Church Steeple
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling terrain as seen from an elevated point of view. The horizon is high, showing where the land meets a pale sky. A church tower stands out at the horizon. The foreground displays muted greens and earth tones, while the background shows a blend of greens, oranges, and browns representing trees and bushes. The scene is painted using a watercolor technique with soft and fluid brushstrokes, creating a dreamy atmosphere. The color palette is delicate and pastel, enhancing the peaceful feeling of the landscape.

artworks.title: Landscape by the Shore with Road in Foreground
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 28.2 x 50.6 cm (11 1/8 x 19 15/16 in.)
support: 29.2 x 51.9 cm (11 1/2 x 20 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a high vantage point overlooking a tranquil body of water. Hills and a distant townscape are visible along the horizon, with some boats and cows grazing on the hilly terrain leading down to the water. The painting features delicate and fluid watercolor brushstrokes capturing the textures of the sky and land in soft blue, beige, and green hues. Large, diffuse clouds float in the sky, casting shadows over the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape with Trees and Water
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with water in the foreground reflecting the surrounding scenery. The horizon is visible slightly above the middle of the composition with trees in the foreground and background. The sky occupies the top portion of the image with soft blue and gray tones. The painting features a blend of natural colors, primarily cool greens and blues with hints of browns and ochres.

artworks.title: Portland Castle, Dorset
artworks.description: The image features a coastal scene with a sandy shore, a small wooden boat on the sand, and the sea meeting the sky at the horizon. A cluster of buildings lies near the shore, with a hill extending into the background. At the top of the hill, there is a small structure. The artwork includes soft, fluffy clouds in the sky and a color palette of pastels, blues, browns, and yellows.

artworks.title: River Scene with Distant Castle
artworks.description: The image portrays a landscape with a body of water in the lower half. The horizon line is located above the middle, bordered by trees leading to a distant building at the center. On the left, there is a slope and steps leading into the water. The brushwork is watercolor style, creating a calm atmosphere. The color palette includes blues for the water, greens and browns for the trees, and a pale sky with light clouds.

artworks.title: Shore Scene with Sailboats (Portland, Dorset?)
artworks.description: The image shows a shoreline looking out towards the sea. A lighthouse is on a pier extending into the water on the left side. The watercolor painting displays gentle and fluid brushstrokes, creating a serene texture. The color palette includes sandy beige, pale blue, and hints of green. Closest to us is a sandy beach with dune grass, while further out, several sailboats are seen on gentle waves. The sky above is a light wash of blue and gray with hints of white clouds.

artworks.title: Clifton Suspension Bridge near Bristol
artworks.description: The image shows a view down a suspension bridge, leading towards the middle where the towers and cables stand out. The horizon is just above the bridge, separating the sky from the landscape below. The brushstrokes are precisely detailed, capturing the scene clearly. The color palette includes warm earth tones for the bridge and cool blues for the sky. Trees and vegetation on either side of the bridge add greenery, balancing nature and architecture. In the distance, the sky is lightly painted with clouds, creating depth in the composition.

artworks.title: Hunworth Church
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon near the top, featuring hills, a village with houses, trees, and a church spire in the distance. The land in the foreground has grass and shrubbery, transitioning to a sky with muted clouds. The color palette includes greens, browns, blues, and grays. The brushwork is detailed and captures the landscape and sky.

artworks.title: Seascape with Lighthouse
artworks.description: The image depicts a rocky coastline with a lighthouse, viewed from the sea. The horizon is low, with swirling clouds filling the sky. The painting shows a sailboat with red sails in the distance. The sea is a mix of blues and greens, with a somber yet dynamic color palette.

artworks.title: Two Sketches of Trees
artworks.description: The image consists of two landscape sketches laid out vertically. The top sketch shows a dirt path extending towards the horizon with trees and hills depicted under a cloudy sky. Loose and impressionistic brushstrokes create a textured appearance in earthy greens, browns, blues, and whites. The bottom sketch shows trees closer to the viewer with a similar style and color palette to the top sketch. The sketches portray landscapes with a relaxed and fluid technique.

artworks.title: Castle Rheban on the River Barrow, Athy
artworks.medium: graphite and black chalk with brown wash on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a serene scene near a body of water. The water's surface reflects its surroundings, while a castle and buildings can be seen in the distance above it. The brushstrokes are soft and applied with watercolor techniques, creating light and shadow through monochrome tones. The color palette is subdued, with browns, greys, and hints of green. Trees and foliage are depicted with light, intricate lines, adding texture to the scene.

artworks.title: On the Bure, near Aylsham, Norfolk
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with buildings by the water's edge in the foreground. The perspective is slightly elevated, revealing distant hills and a sky with clouds. The buildings are styled in rustic colors and centrally placed. Human figures stand by the water, and delicate brushstrokes create an airy feel. The color palette includes warm earthy tones and light blues and greens. Cows are grazing in the distance, and a large tree borders the right side of the scene.

artworks.title: Shane's Castle, Tenants' Dinner
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with green grass in the foreground, buildings with red flags on the horizon, a small body of water, hills in the distance, and trees framing the scene. The sky is clear blue with soft clouds, and the colors used are primarily greens, blues, browns, and reds. Smooth brushstrokes create texture in the clouds and various shades of green.
